FAQBLK

Frequently asked questions as icon cards — every answer visible, indexable, and screen-reader friendly.

Component Skill — components/faq/component-skill.md

Native basis

Sectioning <article>s in a grid — headings + paragraphs, nothing interactive. If you need collapsing answers, that's the [Accordion](../accordion/component-skill.md) (<details name> exclusive), not this block.

Default

Six items; 1 → 2 → 3 columns by container width.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Acme AI?

A personal AI workspace that helps teams cut context switching and finish faster.

Who is Acme AI for?

Creators, teams, and businesses of all sizes.

How much does it cost?

Flexible plans starting at 199 USD — see the pricing section.

Do I need technical skills?

No. It works out of the box with minimal setup.

Can I try it before I buy?

Yes — we offer a demo so you can see how it fits your workflow.

How does Acme handle my data?

All data is encrypted and never shared with third parties.

CSS view file

/* -- FAQ (marketing) -----------------------------------------------
   "Frequently asked questions" as an icon-card grid (each answer is
   visible — no disclosure widget). Cards hold a muted icon tile and a
   question/answer pair. Responsive columns follow container width. */

@layer components {
  .mk-faq {
    container: mk-faq / inline-size;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3rem;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 80rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-inline: 1.25rem;
  }

  .mk-faq-head {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 48rem;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .mk-faq-eyebrow { color: var(--primary); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; }

  .mk-faq-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .mk-faq-grid { display: grid; gap: 3rem; }

  .mk-faq-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 1rem;
    max-width: 36rem;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .mk-faq-icon {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 4rem;
    height: 4rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--muted);

    & svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; color: var(--primary); }
  }

  .mk-faq-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; }

  .mk-faq-question {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .mk-faq-answer { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 1rem; text-wrap: pretty; }

  @container mk-faq (min-width: 30rem) {
    .mk-faq-title { font-size: 2.25rem; }
    .mk-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2.25rem 2.25rem; row-gap: 3rem; }
  }

  @container mk-faq (min-width: 52rem) {
    .mk-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  }

  /* -- Accessibility ------------------------------------------- */
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .mk-faq-icon { border-color: CanvasText; }
  }
}
